name: Toriko no Chigiri ~Kazoku no Tame ni Karada o Sashidasu Ane to Imouto~
original_name: 虜ノ契 ～家族のために身体を差し出す姉と妹～
source:
Due to family circumstances, Yakumo Rio and Yakumo Miyu lived in quite a peculiar environment. When they were little, their parents died, and they were raised by their maternal grandfather, who also happened to be the boss of the yakuza, the Yakumo Group.

They were raised in accordance with their grandfather's policy that they should not relate to the group's customs. The sisters grew sound and without any inconveniences. Rio admired the local nurse, Omigawa Kyouko, and secretly made the decision to become a nurse herself. With Miyu, a spoiled child, she spent her tranquil days, however...

A shadow has started to loom over this tranquility. A new rising group, the Mitsuru Group, invaded Yakumo Group's turf, sought to take the group over. The latter was being pushed back under its rampancy when suddenly its boss fell ill and was taken to the hospital. Thus, bad things continued to keep happening, as if rubbing salt into the wound. The Mitsuru Group appeared to be planning to declare that it was taking the Yakumo Group under its wing at the gathering of groups from all over the region, which would take place about a month later, and have all its neighbors recognize this. In such a case, the group would be taken over...

At that time, a man went to the Yakumo Group estate, where the sense of impending crisis grew stronger and stronger. It was Innami Kouzou, the boss of Innami Group, which has been building its strength lately. Innami shared a story with their group, but he made a certain proposal to help. If they presented him with either Rio or Miyu as his woman until the end of the gathering, he would settle the matter with the Mitsuru Group by then. He was kicked out once, but Rio thought about the group's future and offered to be taken herself.

And so, in order to protect Yakumo Group, Rio came to live as a woman of Innami Group's boss. She more or less anticipated what was to come, but what awaited her were days of humiliation far beyond her expectations.
[i]Would it really settle the dispute? 
And what would become of Rio?..[/i]

[Translated from the [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/guiltyex/ex03/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
由于家庭原因，八云里约和八云美优生活的环境相当奇特。他们很小的时候，父母就去世了，他们是由外祖父抚养长大的，而外祖父恰好也是黑帮八云集团的老大。

他们是按照祖父的政策长大的，即不应该与该群体的习俗发生联系。姐妹俩健康成长，没有任何不便。里约很欣赏当地的护士大江川恭子，并暗暗决定自己也成为一名护士。她和美优这个被宠坏的孩子一起度过了平静的日子，然而……

阴影开始笼罩在这份宁静之上。一个新崛起的集团——满集团，入侵了八云集团的地盘，并试图接管该集团。当后者的老板突然生病并被送往医院时，后者正被其猖獗的势头击退。于是，不好的事情不断发生，就像在伤口上撒盐一样。满集团似乎正计划在一个月后举行的各地团体聚会上宣布将八云集团纳入麾下，并让所有邻国都承认这一点。在这种情况下，小组就会被接管……

当时，一名男子前往八云集团庄园，那里的危机感越来越强烈。正是最近实力不断增强的因波集团的老板因波高三。Innami与他们的小组分享了一个故事，但他提出了一定的建议来提供帮助。如果在聚会结束之前，他们向他推荐里奥或美优作为他的女人，那么他就可以在那时与满集团解决这件事。他曾经被开除过一次，但里奥考虑到了乐队的未来，并主动提出自己被开除。

于是，为了保护八云集团，里约来到了因波集团老大的女人身边生活。她或多或少预料到了接下来的事情，但等待她的却是远远超出她预想的屈辱日子。
[i]这真的能解决争端吗？ 
里约会变成什么样子？..[/i]
